favorite.description: Favorites appear in every space without changing the selected space. Older snapshots restore without the field as non-favorites.

pinned.description: Pinned tabs keep their own section under favorites, per space.

private.description: Private tabs run engine-private sessions and never persist: the controller strips them from saved copies and restore drops them.

bookmarkId.description: The persistent sidebar item owning this tab, independent of its live URL.

homeUrl.description: Saved destination, independent of navigation in the live session.

suspended.description: The saved row remains while its browser session is closed.

updatedAt.description: Last touch in epoch ms; drives the Today/Earlier split (12h archive).

workspaceId.description: Empty only in legacy snapshots, assigned to a Space during restore.

lastExternalRequestId.description: The native incoming-link queue acknowledges FIFO deliveries only after this snapshot is durable. Its head may replay across a bridge restart.

keymapVersion.description: Once migrated, explicitly customized shortcuts are never remapped.
